articles.title: Trump admin moves further into AI oversight, will test Google, Microsoft and xAI models
articles.description: The White House is also considering a new AI working group that would explore potential oversight and vet models before release, CNBC confirmed.

articles.title: Microsoft, Google, xAI give US access to AI models for security testing
articles.description: The deal comes days after the Pentagon announces an agreement with seven tech giants to use AI in classified systems

articles.title: Microsoft Xbox CEO overhauls leadership amid sinking sales: 'We need to evolve how we work'
articles.description: Asha Sharma, the former Instacart and Meta executive who took over Xbox at Microsoft, said the unit doesn't spend enough time with developers and players.
